The top vehicles, legendary weapons, loot houses, money farms, story encounters and quest starts from GTA 6 — pinned on Rockstar's real map of Leonida. Every pin links to an Instagram reel where you can watch it, learn it, and see the visual before you go. Use the two dropdowns below to filter the map: Pin types shows or hides whole types in any combination — just loot, just quests, quests + encounters — and Difficulty filters by how hard each spot is, from Trivial to Hard. The two combine, so you can ask for, say, only Easy quests, or only Hard loot runs. Tap a pin to zoom in: roads, blocks and buildings are on the map itself, and each panel gives you the haul, difficulty, prerequisites, best chapter, and a Watch the reel button. Quest panels add the storyline, who gives it, what kicks it off, chapter / character locks, trophy counting and missable warnings.

Pass 5 — difficulty filter: a second dropdown, Difficulty, sits beside Pin types — multi-select Trivial, Easy, Easy–Moderate, Moderate, Moderate–Hard and Hard in any mix. It is fully separate from pin type and the two combine: a pin shows only when its type and its difficulty are both on, and the selection is remembered on this device. Pass 4 — multi-select pin types + Quest Starts: The old single-tap filter chips are gone. The Pin types dropdown now has a checkbox for every type — Vehicles, Loot & Cash, Legendary Weapons, Money Farm, Stat Boost, Encounter / Story and the new Quest Start — in any combination, with All / None quick actions, and your selection is remembered on this device. New Quest Start type (black pins): the Missing Persons / Serial Killer Trail moves into this type — it starts with the missing-person poster in the Starlet Motel reception, Port Gellhorn, exactly the storyline you asked about — joined by Kirk — Search for the Skunk Ape (flyer at Skeeter's Bar, Hamlet), Kyle — McKittrick Farm crop-duster jobs (a different flyer at the same Starlet Motel) and Bret Vogel — Hunting up at Mount Kalaga. Plus one new encounter: Ghost Road on Sassafras Road (Tier C, reported only). Base map: Rockstar's official printable Leonida map (Nov 19, 2026), with a toggle to the detailed YANIS / GTA VI Mapping Community layer. Positions are district-accurate; exact doors, flyers and hatches are in the steps and the reels.
Pass 6 — no-tracker steals: cars, trucks & off-road: nine new Vehicle pins (37–45) — the best cars, trucks and off-roaders you can steal and keep WITHOUT the Chapter 3 Key Cloner. Every vehicle pin, new and old, now carries a Tracker: line and a Register: line in its panel. Keeping stolen cars: scan first with the WAiNK app — it shows the lock, alarm, tracker, value and registration fee before you commit. No tracker → register at Moses (Watkins Auto Parts, Port Gellhorn) from Chapter 2 — your first registration is free. Standard tracker → a Pay 'n' Spray can register it from Chapter 3. Advanced tracker → needs the Chapter 3 Key Cloner; Moses won't take them, so those cars are deliberately NOT in this pass. An unregistered car is lost if it's destroyed — garage keepers straight away (safehouse garage / Port Gellhorn Garage on Persistence Road). Off-road ranking, where guides agree: the BF Bandito is the highest-rated off-roader in the guide databases, and the Caracara 4x4 family tops the pickup class — both are pinned below.

How to read the tiers: Tier A = from your saved Instagram “GTA” collection (pins 1–10). Tier B = cross-checked — multiple independent reels/guides agree on the spot. Tier C = single-source / tertiary — one reel only, shown because you asked to go deeper; treat those as unverified until more reports land. Every pin links its reel so you can watch the visual yourself. Quest Start pins (black) mark where a storyline begins — the pin is the start point, not the whole quest. Kirk's Skunk Ape strand, Kyle's McKittrick Farm strand and Freddie's “Retest Freddie's Defenses” count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy; Bret's hunting strand has its own trophies and its Strangers & Freaks counting is unconfirmed; the Missing Persons / Serial Killer Trail is a hidden storyline whose trophy counting is likewise unconfirmed. Ghost Road (Sassafras Road), Booker and the Van in the Mud are reported-area encounters, not guaranteed spawns. Five pass-2 spots were removed in pass 3 because no reel could be found for them (Laird 350 Hunting Stand, Marabunta Grande Hobo — Hamlet, Drug Mule KZ-59, Shark Knife, Fairview FF-SR) — they were guide-verified and can return when a reel surfaces. Codes, cash amounts and weapon names are as stated in each source reel/guide. Base maps: Rockstar's official printable map of Leonida (Nov 19, 2026) and the YANIS / GTA VI Mapping Community detailed map (CC BY 4.0 via gtadb.org) — both embedded in the page. GTA VI launched Nov 19, 2026, so locations are launch-week reports and may be patched or refined over time.
